sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the guidance-change framework does not apply; instead, the score reflects whether market expectations are stretched or depressed heading into the print. The document describes a stock down approximately 40% YTD, trading at a modest 12.3x FY2027 EPS estimate, with a price target cut from $200 to $160, indicating depressed expectations and a lowered bar. This low bar raises the odds of a positive surprise reaction even on modest results, supporting a mildly bullish score.
